scripts.healthcheck: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + (process.env.PORT || 4000) + '/health').then(async (res) => { if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Healthcheck failed'); console.log(await res.text()); }).catch((error) => { console.error(error.message); process.exit(1); })"
